questions.prompt: Praise the brave soldiers who defended the city, O citizens.
questions.answer: Laudāte fortēs mīlitēs quī urbem dēfendērunt, ō cīvēs.

questions.prompt: Warn your friend about the coming danger, my son.
questions.answer: Monē amīcum tuum dē perīculō ventūrō, mī fīlī.

questions.prompt: Rule the province justly, mindful of the laws of our ancestors.
questions.answer: Rege prōvinciam iūstē, lēgum māiōrum memor.

questions.prompt: Hear the words of the wise old man, young men.
questions.answer: Audīte verba sapientis senis, iuvenēs.

questions.prompt: Tell the truth to the judge, even if you are afraid.
questions.answer: Dīc iūdicī vērum, etiamsī timēs.

questions.prompt: Lead the weary troops across the river before nightfall.
questions.answer: Dūc fessās cōpiās trāns flūmen ante noctem.

questions.prompt: Do at once what the general has ordered, soldiers.
questions.answer: Facite statim quod imperātor iussit, mīlitēs.

questions.prompt: Bring help to the wounded, and do not delay.
questions.answer: Ferte auxilium vulnerātīs, nōlīte morārī.

questions.prompt: Do not fear death, which comes to all mortals.
questions.answer: Nōlī timēre mortem, quae omnibus mortālibus venit.

questions.prompt: Do not despise the poor, for fortune is fickle.
questions.answer: Nōlīte pauperēs contemnere, nam fortūna mūtābilis est.

questions.prompt: Do not trust the enemy, however many gifts he offers.
questions.answer: Nōlī hostī crēdere, quamvīs multa dōna offerat.

questions.prompt: Do not laugh at those who have stumbled, my friends.
questions.answer: Nōlīte irrīdēre eōs quī lāpsī sunt, amīcī meī.

questions.prompt: Seize the citadel by night while the guards sleep.
questions.answer: Capite arcem noctū dum custōdēs dormiunt.

questions.prompt: Send messengers to the allies, and demand grain.
questions.answer: Mittite nūntiōs ad sociōs, et frūmentum poscite.

questions.prompt: Defend the walls bravely, mindful of your fatherland.
questions.answer: Dēfendite mūrōs fortiter, patriae memorēs.

questions.prompt: Open the gates so that the citizens may flee.
questions.answer: Aperīte portās ut cīvēs fugiant.

questions.prompt: Write to me often while you linger in the fields.
questions.answer: Scrībe ad mē saepe dum in agrīs morāris.

questions.prompt: Carry the sacred torches, maidens, and sing to the goddess.
questions.answer: Ferte facēs sacrās, virginēs, et deae canite.

questions.prompt: Free the captives whom the pirates seized, O consul.
questions.answer: Līberā captīvōs quōs praedōnēs rapuērunt, ō cōnsul.

questions.prompt: Cultivate the fields diligently while the season is favorable.
questions.answer: Colite agrōs dīligenter dum tempus est aptum.

questions.prompt: Do not linger in the city, friends, for the enemy approaches.
questions.answer: Nōlīte in urbe morārī, amīcī, nam hostis appropinquat.

questions.prompt: Build a wall around the camp, soldiers, so that we may be safe.
questions.answer: Facite mūrum circum castra, mīlitēs, ut tūtī sīmus.

questions.prompt: Rule the people justly, king, and they will love you.
questions.answer: Rege populum iūstē, rēx, et tē amābunt.

questions.prompt: Do not despise the poor, who endure many hardships.
questions.answer: Nōlī pauperēs contemnere, quī multa incommoda patiuntur.

questions.prompt: Warn the citizens of the coming danger, senator.
questions.answer: Monē cīvēs dē perīculō ventūrō, senātor.

questions.prompt: Be led by reason, not by anger, my son.
questions.answer: Dūcere ratiōne, nōn īrā, mī fīlī.

questions.prompt: Give food to the hungry crowd, for they have eaten nothing.
questions.answer: Date cibum turbae ēsurientī, nam nihil ēdērunt.

questions.prompt: Do not provoke the raging beast with a spear, hunter.
questions.answer: Nōlī bēstiam saevientem hastā inrītāre, vēnātor.

questions.prompt: Send the letter to my father-in-law before the third hour.
questions.answer: Mitte epistulam socerō meō ante hōram tertiam.

questions.prompt: Soften your harsh words, girl, lest you wound his heart.
questions.answer: Mītigā verba dūra, puella, nē cor eius vulnerēs.

questions.prompt: Defend the walls bravely, young men, while help is awaited.
questions.answer: Dēfendite mūrōs fortiter, iuvenēs, dum auxilium exspectātur.

questions.prompt: Do not believe the rumors spread by the fearful crowd.
questions.answer: Nōlīte rūmōribus ā turbā timidā sparsīs crēdere.

questions.prompt: Read the book that the wise poet wrote long ago.
questions.answer: Lege librum quem poēta sapiēns ōlim scrīpsit.

questions.prompt: Flee the burning house quickly, and save the children.
questions.answer: Fuge domum ārdentem celeriter, et servā līberōs.

questions.prompt: Open the gates, guards, so that the messenger may enter.
questions.answer: Aperīte portās, custōdēs, ut nūntius intret.

questions.prompt: Do not abandon your comrades in the midst of battle.
questions.answer: Nōlī sociōs in mediō proeliō dēserere.

questions.prompt: Carry these gifts to the temple, and pray to the gods.
questions.answer: Fer haec dōna ad templum, et deōs ōrā.

questions.prompt: Teach the boys well, master, that they may become wise.
questions.answer: Docē puerōs bene, magister, ut sapientēs fīant.

questions.prompt: Do not despise the gifts of the gods, foolish young man.
questions.answer: Nōlī deōrum dōna contemnere, stulte iuvenis.

questions.prompt: Carry these letters to the consul with the greatest haste.
questions.answer: Fer hās epistulās ad cōnsulem summā celeritāte.

questions.prompt: Be ruled by wisdom, citizens, not by anger.
questions.answer: Sapientiā regiminī, cīvēs, nōn īrā.

questions.prompt: Speak the truth boldly, witness, though the tyrant threatens.
questions.answer: Dīc vēra audācter, testis, quamquam tyrannus minātur.

questions.prompt: Do not touch the sacred groves, travelers, lest you offend the gods.
questions.answer: Nōlīte lūcōs sacrōs tangere, viātōrēs, nē deōs offendātis.

questions.prompt: Hear the prayers of the suppliants, o gods, and grant peace.
questions.answer: Audīte supplicum precēs, ō dī, et pācem date.

questions.prompt: Turn aside the swift arrows with your left hand, warrior.
questions.answer: Dētorquē celerēs sagittās laevā, bellātor.

questions.prompt: Strike the enemy with the sword, soldiers, and spare no one.
questions.answer: Percutite hostem gladiō, mīlitēs, et nēminī parcite.

questions.prompt: Do not trust the fickle crowd, o consul, which praises today and condemns tomorrow.
questions.answer: Nōlī turbae inconstantī crēdere, ō cōnsul, quae hodiē laudat et crās damnat.

questions.prompt: Endure the harsh winter bravely, farmers, until spring returns.
questions.answer: Ferte hiemem asperam fortiter, agricolae, dum vēr redeat.
